Game guide

How to play Sling Four

A fast slingshot coin game for 2 to 4 players on one screen. Drag a coin to your string, pull it back and let go to fire it into another quarter. Clear your own quarter first to win.

Play Sling FourAll games

The goal

Each player owns one quarter of the board and starts with 4 coins. Fire your coins into the other quarters, and be the first to empty your own.

Controls

ActionTouch or mouseKeyboard
Pick up a coinTouch a coin in your quarterNot used (touch or mouse)
Load the stringDrag the coin to the string across your cornerMouse: drag the same way
Aim and powerPull back further for a harder shot; pull to one side to aimMouse: drag further back
FireLet goRelease the mouse button
PausePause buttonP or Escape

Tips

  • Everyone plays at the same time, so there are no turns. Speed matters.
  • Drag a coin to a free spot in your own quarter first if you want to reposition it before firing.
  • A harder pull sends the coin further, so a gentle pull keeps a shot short.
  • On the start screen, tap a corner to switch a seat between Human and Bot. Easy bots are slow and wild, Hard bots aim for the player with the fewest coins.
  • The board is square and fits any screen, so you can play on a phone laid flat between two to four people.

Questions

Is my progress saved? The game saves how many rounds each colour has won in your browser on your device. Clearing your browser data removes it. See the Privacy Policy.

How many can play? Two to four players on one screen, and any seat can be a bot.

Can I play offline? Yes. Once you have opened the game, you can add it to your home screen and play it like an app, including offline.

Why do ads appear? Scotcha is free to play and supported by Google ads, which may appear between rounds. If ads are blocked or unavailable, the game continues normally.
